title: Run Simulation from Yard Position Zero
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine, $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, $x$ a Boolean input, and $m$ a natural number. For any configuration $a$ of $A$ on $x$, any work-tape contents and head positions for $S$, and any Boolean choice word $u$ with $|u|\le m$, running the host machine on $u$ from the representation of $a$ in phase $	ext{run}$ with yard-head position zero gives the representation of the run of $A$ on $u$ from $a$, with yard-head position $|u|$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a deterministic Boolean Turing machine
$A$ is a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine
work-tape contents and head positions for $S$
$u$ is a Boolean word with $|u|\le m$
